name: GmpChangeControlBoard
tagline: Raise, assess, approve, implement and verify GMP changes – a Change Control Board in one plug-and-play Power Platform control.
description: A complete GMP change control module for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: Minor/Major/Critical change requests, six-area impact assessment (validation, regulatory, stability, training, documents, supplier), regulatory filing category with prior-approval gate, role-based CCB sign-off with four-eyes rule, implementation task plan, effectiveness check and QA closure – with gated workflow, KPIs, milestone schedule and Power Fx events.
features: Gated lifecycle: draft → impact assessment → CCB review → implementation → effectiveness check → closed
Six-area impact assessment with impact profile chart
Regulatory filing categories (Annual report, CBE-0, CBE-30, PAS, Type IA/IB/II) with HA approval gate
Role-based CCB sign-off – Minor and Major/Critical role lists, Regulatory and Validation added automatically when impacted
Four-eyes rule: owner cannot sign, one person one role
Implementation task plan with training-task rule
Effectiveness check with evidence and send-back on failure
Permanent, temporary (max duration, expiry tracking) and emergency changes (retrospective approval)
Milestone schedule with 8-week load strip and controlled extensions
Bulk classify, assign, submit, CSV export
Demo mode with 30 fictional change requests
Phone layout at 320–375 px, keyboard and screen-reader support
